facts.fact: 晚七点顶层 Kai 与姐姐 Maya 争执，Maya 劝他给 Chloe 机会
facts.anchor: Maya leaned against the counter opposite him, her arms folded across her chest

facts.fact: Kai 背对 Maya 说 Chloe 回来只是空地址，拒绝为旧情松口
facts.anchor: She came back to an empty address

facts.fact: Kai 指责 Chloe 一遇麻烦就抽身头也不回，如今想重修旧好
facts.anchor: She chose her exit the second things became inconvenient.

facts.fact: Marcus 短信说起草新采访协议只问创作叙事，确认 Yna 明早来
facts.anchor: Drafted the new media interview protocols.

facts.fact: 读短信后 Kai 脑中 Chloe 期待笑容被 Yna 形象取代
facts.anchor: The image of Chloe’s polished, expectant smile dissolved instantly.

facts.fact: 第二天九点 Yna 出电梯到第40层，神态平静微笑
facts.anchor: the elevator chime rang on the 40th floor

facts.fact: 她停在玻璃隔断外看见他与 Marcus 处理 Q3 预测
facts.anchor: She paused just outside the glass partition of Kai’s corner office.

facts.fact: 【转折】隔玻璃她主动露私密笑，他严厉面具回报真心笑
facts.anchor: Yna tilted her head slightly to the right and offered him a soft, private smile.
